verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's marketing pages say users can 'use APIs to connect your virtual mailbox to the tools you already use,' which indicates some API access exists. However, the pack contains no API reference, endpoint list, authentication details or developer portal showing the product can actually be driven programmatically. Missing for 10: published API reference documentation, evidence of which actions are exposed (e.g., reading scans, requesting forwarding or check deposits), auth and developer-access details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
